node.statement: Only the ambient block-product identity A_0B=E_{11} tensor (X^dagger X) follows by direct matrix multiplication. Under the exact allowed inputs, amplification naturality does not identify B and A_0 with the required amplified compressed corners, does not define A_0 dot B as entrywise compression of the supported block, and does not yield A_0 dot B=E_{11} tensor (X^dagger dot X). Independently, no allowed definition or dependency states the matrix-norm isometry ||E_{11} tensor z||=||z||. Therefore the former compressed-product and norm identities are withdrawn; this node supplies no bridge to ||h u_Q-X^dagger X||, and the zero-padding route remains blocked pending registry-level provisioning of both amplification/corner naturality and matrix-norm identification.
